arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/vm.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof2.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab2.json'))
plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab)
print('after plan maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
r = algo.audit(prof, fab, plan)
print(r['valid'], 'maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
EOF
timeout 900 python3 -B /tmp/vm.py
echo "--- now under a 1GiB address-space limit ---"
bash -c 'ulimit -v 1048576; timeout 900 python3 -B /tmp/vm.py'
